description: This file processes Markdown content to extract segments for translation, handling parsing with the goldmark library, identifying translatable blocks, and applying translations back to the original text.

methods.name: extractSegments
methods.description: Parses Markdown text, walks the AST to identify translatable segments, and returns a sorted list of segments with metadata including hashes and IDs.

methods.name: applyTranslations
methods.description: Reconstructs the original Markdown body by replacing segments with their translated counterparts.
